name: Tree Search for LM Agents (best-first search agent)

system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: we run the multimodal agent from Koh et al. (2024) with the same prompt
system_prompt_style.note: Prompt reused from VisualWebArena agent, rendered with task instruction and observation.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: The input to the agent is a screenshot of the SoM-annotated webpage, and a text description of the elements on the page with their assigned IDs.

observation_format.evidence_quote: This highlights every interactable element on the webpage with a bounding box and a unique ID. The input to the agent is a screenshot of the SoM-annotated webpage
observation_format.note: Default multimodal SoM agent; caption-augmented and text-only agents use the accessibility tree.

tool_call_format.note: Actions emitted as a fixed textual command syntax with bracketed arguments; closest value is cli_flags.

tool_count.evidence_quote:
Table 1: Possible actions A in the (Vi-
sual)WebArena environments.
tool_count.note: Counting the 12 actions listed: click, hover, type, press, new_tab, tab_focus, tab_close, goto, go_back, go_forward, scroll, stop.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote:
Table 1: Possible actions A in the (Vi-
sual)WebArena environments.
edit_primitive.note: Web action space only; no file editing tool.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: we run the multimodal agent from Koh et al. (2024) with the same prompt
tool_schema_source.note: Actions described in a hand-written prompt listing the (V)WA action space.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: We implement our search algorithm on the (V)WA web simulators, but our method is fully general and can be applied to any setting with an interactive environment.
protocol_standardization.note: No protocol mentioned anywhere in the paper.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Our approach is a form of best-first tree search that operates within the actual environment space
loop_primitives.note: Base agent uses ReAct/CoT prompting; search is the default outer loop.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: It is common to leverage prompting techniques, such as ReAct (Yao et al., 2022b), RCI (Kim et al., 2024), or Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting (Wei et al., 2022), to improve the performance of the agent.
planning_granularity.note: Planning is via search over states plus CoT text; no stored plan object.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: We use a language model agent to propose candidate branches of the search tree.
multi_agent_topology.note: One agent plus a value-function model, not a separate agent role.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: We use a language model agent to propose candidate branches of the search tree.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Our work is a research product that aims to advance the development of web agents that can help augment humans by automating computer tasks.
human_in_loop.note: No approval or confirmation mechanism described in the search loop.

short_term_state.evidence_quote:
we begin the search algorithm fromst by initializing the frontierF←{} (implemented
as a max priority queue) which holds the set of states that we plan to evaluate
short_term_state.note: Frontier priority queue, best state, best score and search counter form a structured state beyond messages.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Our procedure is an inference-time approach that is compatible with many of these past approaches that focus on developing better base agents.
long_term_memory.note: No cross-run memory described; ICAL-style memory is cited as related work only.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: During backtracking, we reset the environment and apply the same sequence after resetting the environment.
state_persistence.note: Within-run replay of actions, but no saved state reloaded across interrupted runs.

self_verification.evidence_quote: We implement the value function by prompting a multimodal language model with the task instructionI, screenshots of the agent's trajectory, previous actions the agent took, and the current page URL.
self_verification.note: Groundtruth-reward value function is an ablation only.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: If vp≥θ (i.e., the agent is likely to have found a goal state) ors≥c (the search budget has been exceeded), we will terminate the search
retry_policy.note: Branches are re-expanded until the value threshold is met or the budget is exhausted; closest fit to whole-task retry semantics.

rollback.evidence_quote: During backtracking, we reset the environment and apply the same sequence after resetting the environment.
rollback.note: Environment reset + action replay for backtracking.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Our search parameters are set tod = 5,b = 5,c = 20, and we stop execution after a maximum of 5 actions.
termination_condition.note: stop [answer] action ends with an output (model_declared); max 5 actions and search budget c cap iterations.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: We enforce these constraints due to compute and budget limitations
cost_controls.note: Search budget c and max-action caps act as the compute/cost limit; no caching or routing described.

timeouts.evidence_quote: Our search parameters are set tod = 5,b = 5,c = 20, and we stop execution after a maximum of 5 actions.
timeouts.note: Only iteration caps, which are not timeouts; no time limit reported.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: WebArena (WA) (Zhou et al., 2024b) is a benchmark of 812 tasks across 5 realistic self-hosted re-implementations of popular websites
execution_isolation.note: Actions execute against self-hosted simulated websites via a browser; isolation mechanism not stated explicitly.

network_policy.evidence_quote: we primarily benchmark our method on (V)WA
network_policy.note: Agent operates only on the self-hosted benchmark sites; no explicit network policy reported.

permission_model.evidence_quote: For real world deployment, we will need to restrict the search space to actions that are notdestructive.
permission_model.note: Destructive-action classifier is proposed future work; nothing gates actions in the pinned method.

tracing.evidence_quote: In our approach, we implemented search by keeping track of the sequence of actions required to get to a state.
tracing.note: Action sequences and node values are tracked; no logging system described explicitly.

replayability.evidence_quote: During backtracking, we reset the environment and apply the same sequence after resetting the environment.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: We run experiments on the full set of 910 VisualWebArena (VWA) and 812 WebArena (WA) tasks.
eval_hooks.note: Released code runs on (V)WA which has predefined reward functions: R :S×A → {0, 1}.

guardrails.evidence_quote: One way to address this is to introduce a classifier that predicts when certain actions are destructive, and prevent node expansion for those states.
guardrails.note: Stated as future work, so no guardrail ships in the described system.

target_domain.evidence_quote: we propose an inference-time search algorithm for LM agents to explicitly perform exploration and multi-step planning in interactive web environments

open_source.evidence_quote: Our code and models are publicly released atjykoh.com/search-agents.
open_source.note: Licence not stated in the evidence.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: As an inference time algorithm, our approach can easily be applied to any off-the-shelf language model
model_agnostic.note: Evaluated with GPT-4o, Llama-3-70B-Instruct and LLaVA.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: Our code and models are publicly released atjykoh.com/search-agents.
primary_artifact.note: No repo commit available in evidence; coded from the paper.

first_release_date.note: Basis: arXiv id 2407.01476 implies v1 July 2024; no release tag available.

pinned_version.note: No repo commit given in evidence; pinned to the paper version.
